title: neoleretia dimorpha
intro: Neoleretia dimorpha, commonly known as the Himalayan Yellowhead, is a flowering plant species found in the Himalayan region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, making it useful in treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Neoleretia dimorpha include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and provide protection against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
